qualification: cand.musicae (Music Creation) / Master of Music (MMus) (Music Creation)
accreditationStatus: State institution under the Danish Ministry of Culture
language: Primarily DANISH. Entrance exam can be conducted in English if the applicant does not speak Danish. NOT a fully English-taught programme.
durationEcts: 2 years / 120 ECTS, full-time with compulsory attendance
whatYouStudy: Artistic Development Practice (30 ECTS), Music Creation (10 ECTS), Entrepreneurship (10 ECTS), Electives (10 ECTS), External Integrated Module (30 ECTS), Master's Project (30 ECTS). RMC covers rock, pop, jazz, urban, metal and electronic music.
entryRequirements: 'Completed a Bachelor's degree in music from RMC, a relevant Bachelor's degree in music from another Danish music conservatory, or a relevant Bachelor's degree in music from a foreign music conservatory' (or expected completion by 1 July of the entry year).
acceptsNonMusic: NO (effectively). The requirement is a bachelor's degree in music. RMC 'may recognize other artistically based Bachelor's degrees in music as qualifying' through specific assessment — i.e. still an artistic/music degree. A BSc Software Engineering does not meet this.
portfolioSpec: 2-3 compositions, 10 minutes total, MP3 format; sheet music where applicable; an overview of activity over the last 3 years; bachelor degree documentation. At least 1/3 of the portfolio must be 'composed for and performed by others'.
auditionSpec: Two-round assessment. Round 2 is a LIVE exam at RMC in Copenhagen: presentation of works, oral presentation and interview.
tuitionNonEU: EUR 10,000 per year (Master programme) for non-EU/EEA students. (Bachelor EUR 11,000; APD EUR 9,000.)
otherFees: Application fee DKK 600, non-refundable. Danish residence permit fee. Copenhagen living cost approx DKK 10,000-12,000/month.
totalCostEstimate: EUR 20,000 tuition over 2 years + approx EUR 30,000-34,000 living = approx EUR 50,000-54,000
scholarshipName: No general scholarship — fee exemptions only
scholarships: RMC exempts from fees only: Erasmus Mundus participants, Fulbright or DIS programme participants, students under bilateral agreements, holders of permanent/eligible temporary Danish residency, Afghan interpreters and Ukrainian refugees with valid permits. NO merit tuition waiver for an ordinary Tunisian applicant.
languageRequirement: Danish for the programme itself; English accepted for the entrance exam only. Exact level UNVERIFIED.
deadline: 3 February 2026, 12:00 CET (for the 2026 cycle). For Sept 2027 entry expect a PRIOR-CYCLE deadline of approx 3 February 2027.
